::: {#rem-graph-words}
#### Two uses of the word "graph"

The graph of a function (@def-graph) is a set of ordered pairs:
the relation that the function gives.
The directed graph of a relation (@def-relation-digraph) is a drawing of a relation on a set, with points and arrows.
The two share a word but are different things.
For a function from a set to itself, the directed graph of its graph draws one arrow from each point.

:::
